description:
The best callers of YOUR CabalSpy ID instance for a period (6h, 1d, 7d, 30d):
    each user's callouts in the period, scored by their peak multiples (score_x),
    with average, median, best and summed peak multiple, hits and hit rate (share
    of callouts that reached hit_x), and their best call. Entries carry your own
    user id (external_id). Use for "Who are the best callers this week?".

    Callouts are an extra switched on per instance on request; otherwise this
    returns feature_not_enabled. Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy
    ID instance (no demo).

chain.description: Restrict to one blockchain: solana, bnb, base, eth or rh. Leave empty for all.
chain.title: Chain

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

hit_x.description: The peak multiple that counts as a hit for hits and hit_rate_percent, e.g. 2 for a 2x (default 2, above 1 and at most 1000).
hit_x.title: Hit X

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

min_callouts.description: Only callers with at least this many callouts in the period (1-1000, default 1). Raise it to keep one lucky call from topping the average.
min_callouts.title: Min Callouts

period.description: Callouts made in the last 6h, 1d, 7d (default) or 30d.
period.title: Period

sort.description: avg_peak_x (default), best_peak_x, sum_peak_x, hit_rate, callouts or median_peak_x.
sort.title: Sort

name: csid_callout_leaderboard
